text:
June 25-27
Youth Creative Writing Day Camp with Rev. Dr. Lisa Fox, 10 a.m.-2 p.m., Reedsville Park. Daily lunch and journals provided; no experience needed. Contact Reedsville United Methodist Church for more information and registration.
Sunday, July 12
There will be a farm field day/meeting in the Bruceton area starting at 1 p.m. Parking will take place at the Rex and Peggy Galloway residence. From there participants will travel to Gary Walls farm in Pisgah for a farm tour and then proceed to the Hazel Run Flower Farm located at 406 Greenville School Road. A picnic will take place afterwards at the Galloway Farm. Hamburgers and hot dogs will be provided. Participants are encouraged to bring a covered dish. RSVP would be appreciated. For more information contact any local member of the Preston County Farm Bureau or Patrick Foley at 304-329-0800.
Saturday, Aug. 15
The Preston County 4-H Alumni Picnic has been canceled due to a scheduling conflict.
Recurring events:
Neighbors Helping Neighbors every Tuesday from 6-7:30 p.m. at the St. Edward Catholic Church, 1204 E. State Ave., Terra Alta.
NA/AA meeting notice. All are welcome. Struggling with addiction? You are not alone. Group meets every Thursday from 8-9 p.m. in the basement of the Terra Alta Church of the Nazarene, 107 W. State Ave.
Preston Parkinson’s Support Group is hosted monthly every third Thursday from noon to 1:30 p.m. at Preston Memorial Hospital in the Conference Room. Individuals with Parkinson’s Disease, their caregivers, spouses and friends are welcome to attend.
